# InNetworkAgentRewiring

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process of adjusting synaptic or communication pathways within a neuromorphic network to emulate agent-level topology changes. Bridges multi-agent adaptation with neuromorphic plasticity, enabling biologically inspired, real-time reconfiguration in in-network processing.
